text: Broker Phyllis Johnson holds a 16.4 percent stake in Avila Hospital, supplies 89.3 percent of its claims, and has received 131,790 dollars in transfers against roughly 72,837 dollars of expected commission — an 8.6 percent excess ratio on 684,701 dollars of pair billing. The raw numbers are large, but the clinic is accredited and the stake pattern matches the declared in-house-facilitation arrangement this economy legitimately contains, which softens the score to low. Only 34 percent of the broker's own referrals go to this clinic, so the mutual-capture shape is absent. The excess transfer margin is the one fact a written agreement needs to explain. Next step: request the commission schedule; if it covers the margin, dismiss.
